## Hidebehind (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
CE Medium fey  
**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +8  

**Defense**

 **AC** 19, touch 15, flat-footed 14 (+1 dodge, +4 Dex, +4 natural)  
**hp** 48 (6d6+12)  
**Fort** +3, **Ref** +9, **Will** +4  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 60 ft  
**Melee** 2 claws +6 (1d6+2), bite +6 (1d4+2)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 14, **Dex** 18, **Con** 13, **Int** 10, **Wis** 9, **Cha** 11  
**Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 20  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Skill Focus (Stealth), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +13, Bluff +9, Climb +11, Perception +8, Stealth +16, Survival +5  
**Languages** Common, Sylvan (cannot speak)  

**Special Abilities**

 **Faster than the Naked Eye (Su)** A hidebehind may use its incredible speed to move into any unoccupied space that’s within its movement range (normally 60 feet) without provoking attacks of opportunity or suffering from difficult terrain. Hidebehinds that have had their movement hindered (such as a tanglefoot bag or a successful grapple) must successfully free themselves before using this ability. A hidebehind cannot use this ability if it used it in the previous round.  

 **Lurking Behind Every Tree (Ex)** A hidebehind may use its legendary stealth to hide from attacks. Hidebehinds treat partial cover as cover, and cover as improved cover.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any forest  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** standard
